name: Game Event Gameobject
description: Links gameobject spawns to a game event: the gameobject is spawned while the event is active (positive event id) or despawned for the event's duration (negative event id).

fields.name: Guid
fields.help: Gameobject spawn guid from the gameobject table.

fields.name: Event
fields.help: Game event id (game_event.entry), signed. Positive: the gameobject is only spawned while the event is active (if the guid is part of a pool, all pool members must be listed for the event). Negative: the gameobject is removed for the duration of the event and pool grouping is ignored. 0 is not allowed.
